about: Third-party agent tools vendored whole (owner order 2026-10-24: 'take everything we can learn and every tool we can use'). Each package is copied unchanged from a pinned commit except the listed removals; its licence travels with it. Front door: node studio/studio.mjs toolkit. Guide: toolkit/README.md.

packages.name: impeccable
packages.what: Design director: 24 commands (shape, critique, audit, polish, typeset, colorize, animate, layout, bolder, quieter, distill, harden…) with their playbooks, the craft floor and the absolute bans — web stage D.
packages.changed: Removed the engine launcher (scripts/impeccable, impeccable.cmd): it downloads a binary on first run. The skill's own 'Launcher unavailable' path runs instead (reads PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md directly).

packages.name: ui-ux-pro-max
packages.what: Design-system generator and searchable data: 79 styles, 192 product palettes with reasoning, 74 font pairings, 119 UX rules, GSAP presets, charts, 22 stacks (Python standard library, offline) — web stage B.

packages.name: diagram-design
packages.what: 45 diagram types (architecture, flowchart, sequence, journey, Sankey, Wardley, axonometric…) as one self-contained HTML+SVG file in an editorial design system, light/dark/full/animated variants, brand onboarding.

packages.name: img2threejs
packages.what: Rebuild the object in a reference image as a code-only procedural Three.js model: staged sculpt pipeline (intake → spec → blockout … → rig), quality contract and vision self-correction (Python standard library).
packages.changed: Removed upstream tests and CI scripts.

packages.name: hyperframes
packages.what: HTML → MP4 for agents: the render contract and work loop, the CLI by job, ~450 registry blocks (transitions, titles, kinetic type, captions, charts, maps, 3D, camera moves), Figma brand tokens into video, Remotion→HyperFrames porting.
packages.changed: Kept five of its skills; left out media-use (HeyGen paid media services) and slideshow.

packages.name: video-shotcraft
packages.what: Product-promo craft from real page captures: 124 shot recipe cards (150 shots: camera, data, effects, interaction, opening, outro, rhythm, transition, typography, UI entrance) with tuned parameters and known pitfalls, the six-stage pipeline, aesthetic rules, beat sync, sound design, final review.
packages.changed: Text only: the Remotion template code, demos (TSX), gallery, audio and video assets stay upstream (links in the cards point there).

packages.name: blender-mcp
packages.what: Blender driven by any MCP client: the Blender add-on (socket server inside Blender) + the published server package mcp-for-blender 2.2.4 (scene info, objects, materials, Python in Blender, viewport screenshots, Poly Haven/Sketchfab assets).
packages.changed: Only the add-on and its terms; the server runs from PyPI pinned to 2.2.4 with telemetry off (toolkit/README.md).

packages.name: lemo-styles
packages.what: 59 film-style cards (essence and what it is not, materials, colour logic, type, motion quality, camera grammar, native moves, pitfalls): art-deco, swiss-motion, ukiyoe, risograph, blueprint, hologram-hud, papercut, newsreel… Read with: node studio/studio.mjs styles --library=lemo.
packages.changed: Text only (STYLE.md + style.json); demos, posters and subtitles stay upstream.

packages.name: gsap-skills
packages.what: Official GSAP skills for web stage C: core tweens, timelines, ScrollTrigger, plugins, utils, React, Vue/Svelte, performance. The skill text is MIT. The GSAP library itself is not vendored and is not MIT (GreenSock standard no-charge licence).
packages.changed: Skills only (8 gsap-* folders + llms.txt). Examples, logos and repo docs stay upstream. The GSAP library is added per site, pinned and credited; check gsap.com/standard-license for that client.

packages.name: animation-principles
packages.what: Disney's 12 principles, one skill each (squash and stretch, anticipation, staging, straight ahead vs pose to pose, follow through, slow in/out, arcs, secondary action, timing, exaggeration, solid drawing, appeal). The house critic scores the ones a spec can show.
packages.changed: The 12 principle-focus skills only. The other eleven lenses (domain, role, tool, …) stay upstream.

notVendored.name: Penpot
notVendored.why: A design app, not a file set: its official MCP server runs from npm (@penpot/mcp) against the owner's Penpot account; setup in toolkit/README.md and skill penpot-mcp.

notVendored.name: Remotion agent skills
notVendored.why: No licence file, so copying is not allowed; lessons rewritten in our words (TECHNIQUES.md 2026-10-24). Remotion itself needs a company licence above 3 people.
